context:
Goal: a session that waits on CI subscribes to the PR first, so a finished run wakes it at once (incident: #3302 woke its waiter about 4 minutes late; the consultant's account, unchecked).
Problem (rule): the step says to count, before the warning ships, how often a ready mark comes in a session that merges without waiting, because that is how often the warning would cry wolf. That count is not made. Only you can waive a step's own ship gate (rule verification-cry-wolf-guard-is-spent).
Based on (read): the step note (roadmap/data/steps/ci-wait-subscribes-first.json) names the count as a gate.
Based on (read): the hook only warns, never refuses, fails open on any unreadable input, and costs one transcript read per ready mark (docs/decisions/ci-wait-subscribes-first.md, per the lane; triage did not read it).
Based on (unmeasured): the cry-wolf rate. No count exists. Also unmeasured: whether a PreToolUse warning reaches the model at all; the lane's record says so.
Departs from: main — main has no warning on a ready mark and a rule that names only check-ins; PR #3346 adds a warn-only hook and rewrites the rule to name the subscription first.
Meanwhile: PR #3346 (head cc3dc9ef59c7) stays draft; runner 10 owns the ready mark and merge; the lane starts nothing else.

options.gain: The 4-minute wake gap closes now; a false warning costs you one ignored line.
options.label: Ship now, measure the false-alarm rate after (recommended by the lane)
options.lose: The step's own gate is skipped; the false-alarm rate stays unknown until a lane measures it.

options.gain: It ships with a known false-alarm rate.
options.label: Order a measuring lane first
options.lose: PR #3346 waits on that lane, and the wake gap stays open meanwhile.

options.label: Ship the rule text only; hold the hook
options.lose: The rule stays unenforced, which is what caused the incident.

reply: Closed 22:25 CST Nov 13: you chose a, ship the CI-wait warning now and measure its false alarms after. Filed as ruling own-cry-wolf-gate-waived, which waives the step's own ship gate for PR #3346 only. Step ci-wait-warning-cry-wolf-count holds the measurement after it ships. Triage has told lane ci-wait-subscribes-first and the coordinator.
short: Waive the cry-wolf count before the CI-wait warning ships?
title: Ship the CI-wait warning now and measure its false alarms after, or measure first?
why: Only you can waive a step's own ship gate; the measurement the gate asks for was never made.
